chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. On di gittith. By Asaph.

verses.text: Sing aloud to God our strength. Make joyful noise to di God of Jacob.
Raise song and bring tambourine, di pleasant lyre with harp.
Blow di trumpet for di New Moon, for di full moon, for our feast day.
Because na statute for Israel, ordinance of di God of Jacob.
E appoint am for Joseph as testimony, when e go out over di land of Egypt, where I hear language wey I no understand.
“I remove im shoulder from di burden. Im hands comot from di basket.
You call for trouble, and I rescue you. I answer you for di secret place of thunder. I test you for di waters of Meribah. Selah.
Hear, my people, and I go testify to you, Israel, if you go only listen to me!
No foreign god go dey among you. You no go worship any strange god.
I be di Lord your God, wey bring you up out of di land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I go fill am.
But my people no listen to my voice. Israel no gree for me.
So I give dem up to dem stubborn heart, to waka for dem own counsels.
Oh, if my people go listen to me, if Israel go waka for my ways,
I go quickly subdue dem enemies and turn my hand against dem adversaries.
Dem wey hate di Lord go submit to am, and dem own time go last forever.
But I go feed you with di finest wheat. I go satisfy you with honey from di rock.”
God dey stand for di congregation of God. E dey judge among di gods.
“How long una go judge unjustly and show partiality to di wicked? Selah.
Defend di poor and di orphan. Do justice to di afflicted and di destitute.
Rescue di poor and needy. Deliver dem out of di hand of di wicked.”
Dem no know and no understand. Dem dey waka for darkness. All di foundations of di earth dey shake.
I talk say, “Una be gods, all of una be pikin dem of di Most High.
But una go die like men, and fall like one of di princes.”
Arise, God, judge di earth, because na you go inherit all di nations.

chapters.title: A song. A Psalm by Asaph.

verses.text: God, no keep silent. No hold your peace, and no dey still, God.
Because look, your enemies dey make noise. Dem wey hate you don lift up dem head.
Dem dey plot craftily against your people and consult together against your treasured ones.
Dem talk say, “Come, make we cut dem off so dat dem no go be nation again, and di name of Israel no go dey remembered again.”
Because dem don consult together with one mind. Dem make covenant against you:
di tents of Edom and di Ishmaelites, Moab and di Hagrites,
Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with di inhabitants of Tyre.
Assyria also don join dem. Dem don become arm to di sons of Lot. Selah.
Do to dem as to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin for di river Kishon,
wey perish for Endor, wey become like dung for di earth.
Make dem nobles be like Oreb and Zeeb. Yes, all dem princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
wey talk say, “Make we take for ourselves di pastures of God as possession.”
My God, make dem be like whirling dust, like chaff before di wind.
As fire dey burn di forest, as flame dey set di mountains on fire,
so pursue dem with your tempest and terrify dem with your storm.
Fill dem faces with shame, so dat dem go seek your name, Lord.
Make dem dey ashamed and dismayed forever. Yes, make dem confuse and perish,
so dat dem go know say you alone, wey get di name di Lord, na di Most High over all di earth.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. On di gittith. A Psalm by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: How lovely your dwelling places dey, Lord of Armies!
My soul long, yes, even faint for di courts of di Lord. My heart and my flesh cry out for di living God.
Yes, di sparrow don find home, and di swallow don find nest for imself, where e go put im young, even your altars, Lord of Armies, my King and my God.
Blessed na dem wey dey live for your house. Dem go always dey praise you. Selah.
Blessed na di man wey im strength dey for you, wey get highways for im heart.
Passing through di Valley of Weeping, dem make am spring. Yes, di early rain cover am with blessings.
Dem go from strength to strength. Every one of dem appear before God for Zion.
Lord God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
Look at our shield, God. Look on di face of your anointed.
Because one day for your courts better pass 1,000 elsewhere. I go prefer to be doorkeeper for di house of my God pass to dwell for di tents of wickedness.
Because di Lord God na sun and shield. Di Lord go give grace and glory. No good thing go e withhold from dem wey waka uprightly.
Lord of Armies, blessed na di man wey trust you.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by di sons of Korah.

verses.text: Lord, you don show favor to your land. You don restore di fortunes of Jacob.
You don forgive di iniquity of your people. You don cover all dem sin. Selah.
You don take away all your wrath. You don turn from di fierceness of your anger.
Restore us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
You go dey angry with us forever? You go draw out your anger to all generations?
You no go revive us again, so dat your people go rejoice for you?
Show us your faithful love, Lord, and grant us your salvation.
I go hear wetin God di Lord go speak, because e go speak peace to im people and to im holy ones, but make dem no turn again to folly.
Surely im salvation dey near to dem wey fear am, so dat glory go dwell for our land.
Faithful love and truth don meet together. Righteousness and peace don kiss each other.
Truth dey spring out of di earth, and righteousness dey look down from heaven.
Yes, di Lord go give wetin good, and our land go yield im increase.
Righteousness go go before am and make path for im steps.
Bow down your ear, Lord, and answer me, because I dey poor and needy.
Preserve my soul, because I dey godly. You be my God. Save your servant wey trust you.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because I dey cry to you all day long.
Bring joy to di soul of your servant, because to you, Lord, I lift up my soul.
Because you, Lord, good and ready to forgive, plenty for faithful love to all dem wey call on you.
Give ear, Lord, to my prayer. Listen to di voice of my supplications.
For di day of my trouble I go call on you, because you go answer me.
Among di gods, no one dey like you, Lord. No works dey like your works.
All di nations wey you don make go come and worship before you, Lord. Dem go glorify your name.
Because you dey great and do wondrous things. You alone na God.
Teach me your way, Lord. I go waka for your truth. Unite my heart to fear your name.
I go praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart. I go glorify your name forevermore.
Because your faithful love toward me great. You don deliver my soul from di lowest Sheol.
God, di proud don rise up against me. Di company of violent men don seek my soul, and dem no set you before dem.
But you, Lord, na God full of mercy and grace, slow to anger and plenty for faithful love and truth.
Turn to me and have mercy on me. Give your strength to your servant and save di son of your servant girl.
Show me sign of your goodness, so dat dem wey hate me go see am and dey ashamed, because you, Lord, don help me and comfort me.

chapters.title: By di sons of Korah. A Psalm. A song.

verses.text: Im foundation dey for di holy mountains.
Di Lord love di gates of Zion more pass all di dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things dem dey speak about you, city of God. Selah.
“I go mention Rahab and Babylon to dem wey know me. Look, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia: dis one dem born dere.”
Yes, of Zion e go dey talk say, “Dis one and dat one dem born inside am,” and di Most High imself go establish am.
Di Lord go record, when e register di peoples: “Dis one dem born dere.” Selah.
Singers and dancers alike go talk say, “All my springs dey for you.”

chapters.title: A song. A Psalm by di sons of Korah. For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Mahalath Leannoth. A contemplation by Heman di Ezrahite.

verses.text: Lord, di God of my salvation, I don cry day and night before you.
Make my prayer enter your presence. Bend your ear to my cry.
Because my soul full of troubles, and my life don near Sheol.
I dey counted with dem wey go down to di pit. I be like man wey no get help,
free among di dead, like di slain wey lie for di grave, wey you no remember again, and wey dem don cut off from your hand.
You don put me for di lowest pit, for dark places, for di depths.
Your wrath lie heavy on me. You don afflict me with all your waves. Selah.
You don put away my friends from me. You don make me abomination to dem. I shut up, and I no fit come out.
My eye dey dim because of affliction. Lord, I don call on you every day. I don spread out my hands to you.
You go show wonders to di dead? Di dead go rise up and praise you? Selah.
Dem go declare your faithful love for di grave? Your faithfulness for destruction?
Dem go know your wonders for di dark? Your righteousness for di land of forgetfulness?
But I, Lord, don cry to you. For morning my prayer go come before you.
Lord, why you dey reject my soul? Why you dey hide your face from me?
I don dey afflicted and ready to die from my youth. I dey bear your terrors. I dey distracted.
Your fierce wrath don go over me. Your terrors don cut me off.
Dem surround me like water all day long. Dem don completely close in on me.
You don put lover and friend far from me, and my close friends na darkness.

chapters.title: A contemplation by Ethan di Ezrahite.

verses.text: I go sing of di faithful love of di Lord forever. With my mouth I go make your faithfulness known to all generations.
Because I talk say, “Faithful love go dey built up forever. You go establish your faithfulness for di heavens.”
“I don make covenant with my chosen one. I don swear to David my servant,
‘I go establish your offspring forever and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
Di heavens go praise your wonders, Lord, your faithfulness also for di assembly of di holy ones.
Because who for di skies fit compare with di Lord? Who among di sons of di mighty fit be like di Lord,
God wey dey greatly feared for di council of di holy ones, and wey dey awesome above all wey dey round am?
Lord God of Armies, who dey mighty like you, Lord? Your faithfulness dey round you.
You rule di raging of di sea. When im waves rise, you calm dem.
You don break Rahab to pieces, like one wey dem don kill. You don scatter your enemies with your mighty arm.
Di heavens na your own. Di earth also na your own. Di world and all wey full am, you don found dem.
North and south, you don create dem. Tabor and Hermon dey rejoice for your name.
You get mighty arm. Your hand strong, and your right hand lifted high.
Righteousness and justice na di foundation of your throne. Faithful love and truth dey go before your face.
Blessed na di people wey know di joyful shout. Dem dey waka for di light of your face, Lord.
For your name dem dey rejoice all day, and for your righteousness dem dey exalted.
Because you be di glory of dem strength, and for your favor our horn go dey lifted up.
Because our shield belong to di Lord, and our King to di Holy One of Israel.
Den you speak for vision to your faithful ones and talk say, “I don help one wey mighty. I don lift up one chosen from di people.
I don find David my servant. With my holy oil I don anoint am,
wey my hand go be with am. My arm go also strengthen am.
No enemy go outwit am. No wicked man go afflict am.
I go beat down im adversaries before am and strike dem wey hate am.
But my faithfulness and my faithful love go dey with am. For my name im horn go dey lifted up.
I go set im hand on di sea and im right hand on di rivers.
E go cry to me say, ‘You be my papa, my God and di rock of my salvation.’
I go also make am my firstborn, di highest of di kings of di earth.
I go keep my faithful love for am forever, and my covenant go stand firm with am.
I go make im offspring endure forever and im throne as di days of heaven.
If im pikin dem forsake my law and no waka for my judgments,
if dem break my statutes and no keep my commandments,
den I go punish dem sin with rod and dem iniquity with stripes.
But I no go take my faithful love from am, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
I no go break my covenant or change wetin my lips don talk.
One time I don swear by my holiness: I no go lie to David.
Im offspring go endure forever, and im throne as di sun before me.
E go dey established forever like di moon, di faithful witness for di sky.” Selah.
But you don rejected and despised. You don dey angry with your anointed.
You don renounce di covenant of your servant. You don defile im crown for di ground.
You don break down all im walls. You don bring im strongholds to ruin.
All wey pass by dey rob am. E don become reproach to im neighbors.
You don lift up di right hand of im adversaries. You don make all im enemies rejoice.
Yes, you turn back di edge of im sword and no help am stand for battle.
You don end im splendor and throw im throne down to di ground.
You don shorten di days of im youth. You don cover am with shame. Selah.
How long, Lord? You go hide yourself forever? Your wrath go burn like fire?
Remember how short my time be. For wetin you don create all di pikin dem of men for emptiness?
Which man go live and no see death? E go deliver im soul from di power of Sheol? Selah.
Lord, where your former faithful love dey, wey you swear to David for your faithfulness?
Remember, Lord, di reproach of your servants, how I bear for my heart di taunts of all di mighty peoples,
wey your enemies don taunt, Lord, wey dem don taunt di footsteps of your anointed.
Blessed be di Lord forever. Amen and amen.

chapters.title: A prayer by Moses, di man of God.

verses.text: Lord, you don be our dwelling place for all generations.
Before dem born di mountains, or before you form di earth and di world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you be God.
You turn man back to dust, and talk say, “Return, una pikin dem of men.”
Because 1,000 years for your sight na like yesterday when e pass, like watch for di night.
You sweep dem away like dem sleep. For morning dem be like grass wey dey grow.
For morning e dey flourish and grow. For evening e dey cut down and wither.
Because we dey consumed by your anger, and by your wrath we dey troubled.
You don set our iniquities before you, our secret sins for di light of your face.
Because all our days dey pass away for your wrath. We dey finish our years like sigh.
Di days of our years na 70, or if because of strength 80. Yet dem pride na labor and trouble, because e dey quickly pass and we dey fly away.
Who know di power of your anger, and your wrath according to di fear wey dey due you?
So teach us to number our days, so dat we go get heart of wisdom.
Return, Lord. How long? Have compassion on your servants.
Satisfy us for morning with your faithful love, so dat we go rejoice and dey glad all our days.
Make us glad according to di days wey you don afflict us, and di years wey we don see evil.
Make your work dey seen by your servants, and your glory by dem pikin dem.
Make di favor of di Lord our God dey on us. Establish di work of our hands for us. Yes, establish di work of our hands.
